paragraphs: Hello! I am Sam. Today I make a toy road. I have a toy truck and a toy helicopter. You can make a road too. Get a rug, a box, and some books. Get a chair too. Do you want to try?

One, put the rug on the floor. The rug is the road. Two, put the books next to the rug. Three, put the box at the end of the rug. The box is a home for the truck. Four, put the chair next to the box. Five, put the truck on the rug. Six, put the helicopter on the chair. Go! The truck goes to the box. Zoom, zoom!

Now ask a friend, "Where is the truck?" Your friend gives an answer. "It is in the box!" Then ask, "Where is the helicopter?" "It is on the chair!" Play with your friend on the road. It is big fun! I love it! Make a road for the helicopter.
text.summary: Sam shows how to make a toy road on the floor with a rug, books, a box, and a chair. Then you ask a friend where the toy truck is.
